scripts.test: t() { f=; for a in "$@"; do case "$a" in -*) ;; *) f=1 ;; esac; done; if [ -z "$f" ]; then set -- "$@" pi/test/*.test.ts pi/test/compact-tools/*.test.ts pi/test/ask-user-question/*.test.ts pi/skills/skill.test.ts; fi; node --test "$@"; }; t
scripts.verify:node: (t=$(mktemp -d) && TMPDIR=$t pnpm test; s=$?; rm -rf "$t"; exit $s)
scripts.verify:build: export CPD_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && scripts/cargo.sh nextest run --workspace --no-run
scripts.verify:rust: export CPD_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && PATH="$PWD/scripts/tripwire:$PATH" scripts/cargo.sh nextest run --workspace
scripts.verify:steps: pnpm run verify:migrations && pnpm run verify:portable && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run verify:pi && pnpm run verify:build && pnpm run verify:node && pnpm run verify:rust
